upgrade_staged.note: Staged 2026-11-08 10:27 UTC with `stage_upgrade` (1 yocto, refunded). This is the build that must land: it carries FIVE fixes. (1) The hydrate fix, so `anchor` stops panicking ERR_NO_CHARTER. (2) The charge_acts fix, so an effect budget is paid from the side reserve instead of the row's own bytes. (3) The hold fix: `propose_call_as` charged the per-action hold record entirely against the reserve, and the call carries no deposit, so a row whose reserve was spent by /setup's own effect budget panicked ERR_DEPOSIT — pressing Post job sent 3sAWZghNXW9nph7vTKjGjBjWsdEHpsqfg88npgzQUrYt and the board refused it, and the same write blocks every held payment and the toll crossing. The hold is now paid from the reserve first, then from the row's own room. (4) The close fix: `release` refunded the side reserve but never subtracted it from `owed`, so after ANY row carrying a call list was closed the liability ledger stayed above zero forever and `reap` refused ERR_LIABILITY. Measured in contracts/charter_board_sandbox/tests/two_visitors.rs: owed read 0.00734 NEAR and never moved. Proved in tests/hold_on_a_hall_row.rs and tests/two_visitors.rs. Supersedes the 23:36 stage (CCTpHQ1Y…), which had only fixes 1 and 2 and would have left hold and reap broken. Re-staging reset the 24 h ETA. (5) The min_amount fix: `min_amount` was applied to every `propose_call_as` deposit, so the zero-value steps of the Town Hall lifecycle (bid, accept, deliver, review, refund) were refused below_min_amount. Measured on mainnet 2026-11-08 after post_job landed: `bid` with a zero deposit was refused, and zero is the only deposit a bid can carry. It now applies only when the call moves value. Proved in contracts/charter_board/src/lib.rs a_shop_call_with_no_value_is_not_held_to_the_smallest_payment. SIXTH fix, staged 2026-11-08 16:29 UTC after the field analysis: a free `simulate` view, so an agent can ask 'would this be allowed?' and get the same words the send would use, instead of learning refusal reasons by burning gas. Exposed at POST /api/board/simulate, and a board build without it answers ok:null rather than ok:true. Re-staging reset the 24 h ETA from 2026-11-09 10:27 to 16:29 UTC; no further re-stage unless a money-losing bug appears.

known_bugs.detail: charge_acts and the propose_call_as hold path add the full storage cost to `owed` even when the side reserve paid it, and that reserve was already counted. After the last row closed on 2026-11-09, get_liabilities read 0.00483 NEAR with 0 rows. reap refuses ERR_LIABILITY, so the board can no longer be torn down. It needs an upgrade that fixes the ledger and recomputes owed.
propose_call lets `stamp` on the board itself through without the board being in receivers, but simulate answers receiver_not_allowlisted for it.
extern new() had no state check; any account could become owner and reap. The 21:27 reap went through exactly that path, from the owner, to clear the drifted owed.

caller.NOT_DEPLOYED: Not deployed on 2026-11-08: the stake for a 167 KB contract is ~1.673 NEAR and free NEAR across the whole city is 2.43 NEAR, so deploying it would commit 69% of every liquid yocto while the board upgrade is still pending. The stake is recoverable (the contract's close() deletes the account and returns every yocto), so this is a reversible step that waits for the upgrade rather than being abandoned. Deploy with: node .secrets/deploy-attested.mjs --send
caller.deploy_command: node .secrets/deploy-attested.mjs --send (creates the caller account when run)

outlayer.note: The Guardhouse can ask OutLayer to run this checker in a TDX enclave and resume the transaction with the result. It is NOT wired into the tray yet and NO attested decision has been produced on mainnet.
